Scope and production notes

The film is an animated execution of illustrative examples, not a recording of a deployed Greywolf system or a claim about processing speed. The research example uses source values from an actual public Apple filing. Back-office reports and policies are entirely fictional. No Greywolf files, positions, investment notes or policies were used.

Code checks can catch defined failure cases; they do not establish universal accuracy. Exceptions and questionnaire drafts still need human review. No payments, compliance submissions or investment decisions are performed. Build and handover are the proposed service, not completed client work.

This standalone page has no forms, analytics, local storage or background requests. The public-source link in the research inspector opens the original filing. The invitation uses the supplied November 2026 dates and build-ahead commitment, pending content review before circulation.

Animation was built with AI-assisted code and checked against the source data and test fixtures. The temporary narration uses the installed macOS Samantha voice and original synthesized sound effects. ElevenLabs returned HTTP 429 for the single new Boston request; its node remains not_run. The earlier Boston recording is preserved separately.
